sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
sources.text: The latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 Thursday, November 19, available at PlayStation Store. The game is set in the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet. Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him. Jason knows how he’d like it to turn out but right now, it’s hard to tell. Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk, and life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out but now more than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. Instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands. Leonida is made up of six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga. Here’s a closer look at what makes each region unique. The glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city. Each neighborhood has something to offer, from the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands of Ocean Beach, to the bustling panaderías of Little Cuba and the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market, out to the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world. We’re a long way from the ’80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America Life in this tropical archipelago isn’t flashy but it’s easy. Get your buzz on and pull up a deck chair but look out — you are right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America. You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse. The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves. Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won’t bring the tourists back, but there’s a new economy in this once-popular vacation spot. It’s fueled by malt liquor, painkillers, and truck stop energy drinks. In the heart of Leonida, American industry and old school values still reign supreme — whatever the cost. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs, while the local biker gang provides almost everything else. A national landmark up against the state’s northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails. In the lush surrounding backwoods, hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live far from the prying eyes of the government. Spanning stations including Classic Rock, Modern Hip-Hop, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latin, ‘80s, Electronic, Blues, Ballads, Talk Radio, and much more, Grand Theft Auto VI features the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet. Plus, for the first time ever, Grand Theft Auto VI introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida’s terrestrial radio, with both radio and podcasts available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones.

sources.text: O mais novo título da série Grand Theft Auto nos leva ao estado de Leonida, até as ruas iluminadas de neon de Vice City e além. Jason e Lucia sempre souberam que as cartas não estavam a favor deles. Mas quando o que deveria ser um trabalho fácil dá errado, eles se encontram no lado mais escuro do lugar mais ensolarado da América, no meio de uma conspiração criminosa que cobre todo o estado de Leonida, forçados a depender um do outro mais do que nunca se quiserem sair vivos. Grand Theft Auto VI chega para PlayStation 5 quinta-feira, 19 de novembro, disponível na PlayStation Store. O jogo se passa no estado de Leonida, onde ficam as ruas banhadas de neon de Vice City e além, na maior e mais imersiva evolução da série até hoje. Jason cresceu rodeado de bandidos e vigaristas. Após um período no exército para tentar se livrar de sua adolescência perturbada, ele se encontra nos Keys fazendo o que faz melhor, trabalhando para traficantes de drogas locais. Conhecer Lucia pode ser a melhor ou a pior coisa que já aconteceu com ele. Jason sabe como gostaria que tudo terminasse, mas agora, é difícil prever. O pai de Lucia a ensinou a lutar desde que ela aprendeu a andar, e a vida tem vindo com tudo para cima dela desde então. Lutar por sua família a colocou na Penitenciária de Leonida. Sorte pura a livrou desta vez, mas agora mais do que qualquer coisa, Lucia deseja a vida boa com a qual sua mãe sonhava desde que moravam em Liberty City. Em vez de fantasias pela metade, Lucia está preparada para assumir o controle da situação. Leonida é composto de seis regiões: Vice City, as Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, e Mount Kalaga. Vamos conhecer o que torna cada região única. O glamour, o trabalho e a ganância da América capturados em uma única cidade. Cada bairro tem algo a oferecer, dos hóteis de art deco, cores pastel e areia branca de Ocean Beach, até as padarias de Little Cuba e as marcas falsificadas do mercadinho de Tisha-Wocka, até o VC Port, a capital mundial dos navios de cruzeiro. Estamos longe dos anos 80, mas Vice City ainda é a capital do sol e da diversão da América. A vida neste arquipélago tropical não é chamativa, mas é boa. Pegue uma cervejinha e puxe uma cadeira de praia, mas tome cuidado, você está à beira das águas mais belas e perigosas da América. Você nunca sabe o que está sob a superfície desta região primordial. Os jacarés podem ser a atração mais famosa, mas há predadores bem mais perigosos e descobertas mais estranhas entre o manguezal. Motéis baratos, atrações fechadas, e galerias de lojas vazias e abandonadas não vão trazer os turistas de volta, mas há uma nova economia neste local que já foi um ponto turístico. Agora mandam o as bebidas baratas, remédios contra a dor e bebidas energéticas. No coração de Leonida, a indústria Americana e os antigos valores ainda reinam supremos, seja qual for o custo. A refinaria de açúcar Allied Crystal providencia os empregos, e a gangue de motociclistas local providencia quase todo o resto. Um marco nacional na fronteira norte do estado, Mount Kalaga oferece as melhores trilhas off-road e pontos de pesca e caça. Nas florestas em torno, caipiras místicos e radicais paranóicos vivem longe dos olhos vigilantes do governo. Com estações de Rock Clássico, Hip-Hop Moderno, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latina, Anos 80, Electrônica, Blues, Baladas, Talk Radio, e muito mais, Grand Theft Auto VI possui a maior e mais variada seleção de rádios em um jogo até hoje. Além disso, pela primeira vez, Grand Theft Auto VI apresenta uma série de podcasts sob demanda para Jason e Lucia ouvirem além das rádios de Leonida, com ambos disponíveis para ouvir em veículos e a pé usando fones de ouvido e earbuds conectados aos seus smartphones.

sources.text: You can never have too many board games. With video games and TV dominating our attention on a daily basis, there's nothing better than sitting down and having a physical experience with your family and friends. A good game of Monopoly or Scrabble is always entertaining, but if you're looking to upgrade to something a bit more modern, Black Friday sales are a great time to do so. Amazon just dropped a number of Lightning Deals on some of our favorite modern tabletop games in 2026. Amazon's Black Friday sale kicked off on November 19, so these board game deals are new to today. You can dive into our top picks right here or scroll down for some of IGN's reviews on these games. Seeing as these are Lightning Deals, we don't expext these discounts to last through the weekend. The majority of Amazon's new board game deals are from Asmodee. That's not too surprising considering they own a variety of different studios. While we haven't reviewed every board game on this list, we have played all of them and can attest to just how fun they are. If you're looking for new tabletop experiences, any of these options are an easy recommendation. You can check out some of our hands-on reviews with these games below if you want to know more about the experience. This is one of the best Lord of the Rings board games on the market right now. We gave it an 8 out of 10 score in our review : "Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship expands on the 2008's Pandemic game system and manages to create one of the best Lord of the Ring tabletop experiences out there, but its increased reliance on random card draws and dice rolls can lead to some turns feeling wasted, or that you are biding your time for what you need, detracting from the game's excitement." - Scott White If you're looking for a racing board game, look no further than this one right here. We gave this game a 9 out of 10 in our review : "Heat: Pedal to the Metal is a vivid and delightful racing board game that surpasses the accomplishments of all that came before it. It’s an inspired title in both product and design, offering a range of options while presenting a dynamic racing system that is extremely impressive." - Charlie Theel For a fun and unique family board game , Harmonies is an excellent choice. We gave it an 8 out of 10 in our review : "Harmonies masterfully blends its drafting system and token-laying mechanics to create a satisfying gameplay loop with just the right amount of tension in its decision-making. At its core, it's an elegant optimization puzzle that offers a fresh challenge every time you play. The added verticality introduces another layer of strategy as you work to build the perfect mix of habitats. Its playful, inviting design features vibrant colors and beautifully illustrated animal cards that are a joy to engage with throughout the game. It's quick to set up and easy to teach, making it a great fit for families and couples, while still offering enough crunchy decisions to keep seasoned players satisfied." - Matt Adler If you're looking for a fun strategy game with civilization elements, 7 Wonders will be right up your alley. It's not for everyone, but it's still worth picking up at this price. We gave it a 7 out of 10 in our review : "You can’t argue with the sheer number of copies that 7 Wonders has sold, nor the plethora of awards that it has accrued. This is a fun game, a good way to pass a half hour, with a great balance of luck and strategy. But it got that way by spreading itself quite thin, making a lot of gamers fairly happy rather than bringing ecstasy to smaller fanbases. There are times when the lack of theme and long-term strategy makes it feel more like an exercise than a game and it’s a tad too involved for casual family play. But whatever kind of games you like, if you fancy taking the plunge, you’re almost guaranteed to find plenty of enjoyment." - Matt Thrower Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. After years of trailers, delays, rumours, and more leaks than Rockstar Games would probably care to count , we can finally get our hands on one of the most anticipated games of all time. GTA 6 is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S , having officially launched on November 19, 2026. And while plenty of players will already have their consoles hooked up and ready to go, there are still some pretty important questions worth asking: which console actually offers the best way to play GTA 6? Is it worth upgrading to a PS5 Pro? And should you even buy a console for it, or simply wait for the inevitable PC release instead ? Look, there's no doubt that the vast majority of players will end up playing GTA 6 on PS5 . Sony's console has a sizeable lead over Xbox Series X|S, with around 95 million PS5 consoles sold , compared with an estimated 35 million Xbox Series X|S consoles . But it's not quite as simple as saying, "play it on PS5, like everyone else." For starters, plenty of people still haven't made the jump to the current generation. If you're still playing on PS4 or Xbox One, GTA 6 could well be the game that finally convinces you to upgrade. Unfortunately, you couldn't have picked a much more expensive time to do it, with console prices, games, storage, and just about everything else seemingly getting pricier by the minute. It's a sign of the times, I'm afraid. Then there's the question of performance. Rockstar's latest open-world adventure is an enormously ambitious game, and the standard PS5 and Xbox Series X|S have their work cut out for them. The PS5 Pro, meanwhile, has considerably more horsepower than the standard PS5, along with PSSR upscaling, making it an interesting option for anyone looking to get the best possible experience. The PS5 Pro is certainly the console I'd be looking at if money were no object. It has a more powerful GPU than the standard PS5, improved ray tracing capabilities, and Sony's PSSR upscaling technology, all of which should help it get more out of demanding games. That doesn't automatically make it a worthwhile upgrade, though. I'd be wary of spending hundreds of dollars extra on a PS5 Pro purely for the promise of better performance in GTA 6 . There's a difference between getting a sharper image or more consistent performance and suddenly unlocking a completely different experience. Whether those improvements justify the considerable price premium is another matter entirely. That being said, if you forced me to give an answer, the PS5 Pro is still probably the best option for getting the most out of GTA 6 on console. If only it wasn't so horrendously expensive, and so difficult to find at a reasonable price right now. If you don't already own a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S , GTA 6 presents a slightly awkward conundrum. On the one hand, this is arguably the biggest game release of the generation ( and probably of all time, quite honestly ), and you're probably going to want to play it ASAP. On the other, buying an entire console for one game is an increasingly expensive proposition in 2026. Sony's current US prices put the PS5 Digital Edition at $599.99 , the standard PS5 with a disc drive at $649.99 , and the PS5 Pro at a frankly eye-watering $899.99 . Microsoft isn't doing much better, with the Xbox Series S now costing $499.99 and the Xbox Series X reaching $749.99 for the digital model or $799.99 with a disc drive. Yikes. Yet, somehow, despite these bonkers prices, there's somehow also an argument for buying sooner rather than later. Console prices have been consistently heading in the wrong direction, and the broader component shortage isn't exactly helping. Major retailers have already warned that console stock could struggle to keep up with demand over the holiday period, with one senior games buyer claiming retailers have been told they won't receive the number of consoles they want ahead of GTA 6's launch. That's not exactly a guarantee that you'll be fighting scalpers for a PS5 come November, though. Sony insists it has secured enough memory to hit its PS5 sales target for the financial year, despite the ongoing component difficulties. Yet, with GTA 6 expected to drive a huge upgrade cycle, I'd rather have my console sorted well before November 19 than find myself scrambling for one at the last minute. Still, if you can, I would still avoid rushing out and paying full price for a console simply because GTA 6 is coming. If you're starting from scratch, keep an eye out for bundles, retailer promotions, trade-in offers, and, particularly as we get closer to November, any GTA 6-specific console deals that might appear. Honestly, refurbished is where I'd be looking right now if you're trying to keep the cost of getting GTA 6-ready as low as possible. You're not going to get much of a discount on brand-new PS5 hardware at the moment, so a reputable refurbished model can make considerably more sense. That's why the next deal I'd consider is a certified refurbished PS5 directly from PlayStation through the PS Direct store . A refurbished PS5 is currently $549, while the refurbished PS5 Digital Edition is $499. If you're happy with digital games, the $499 refurbished PS5 Digital Edition is arguably the most compelling option of the lot, particularly if GTA 6 is the main reason you're buying a console in the first place . ICYMI: Sony has also announced plans to stop producing physical game discs for new PlayStation releases from January 2028, meaning we're potentially looking at the final few years of physical PlayStation gaming. That doesn't mean your existing discs suddenly become useless, or that physical games are disappearing overnight, but it does make the $50 saving on a Digital Edition a little more tempting if you're starting from scratch and don't have an existing physical library. sources.text: In the Chapter 3 mission Dubious Provenance, should you trust, or not trust, the eccentric antiques dealer? Deciding whether to give the statue to Benedict Halifax is a decision you'll need to make during the fourth story mission of Chapter 3 in GTA 6 , called Dubious Provenance. This mission will kick off after Cal visits the Bayside apartment you're borrowing from Boobie to inspect the hard drive. Once Cal leaves, you'll see an icon of a statuette at the closet door. Remember, you didn't just acquire a hard drive but a bronze statuette in Chapter 1, and if you interact with it now the mission will begin. First, you need to drive to Capri, a ritzy town on the other side of the map. At the antiques store, Evelyn Andrews tells you she isn't interested in the obviously stolen item, but art dealer Benedict Halifax approaches you on the sly and says he can have it appraised for you. Should you give the statue to him? So, you might as well just give it to him. Things shake out the same way no matter what you choose, but not giving it to him just means the mission will ultimately take longer to complete. sources.text: Choosing whether to sell to Donnie or Brian isn't just about who pays more After the Clean Up After Donnie GTA 6 mission , Donnie becomes a fence you can sell narcotics, marked notes, and jewelry to, all you have to do is drop them in the deposit box at his trailer in Key Lento. But with Brian also a fence, you may be wondering whether it's more beneficial to sell your goods to Donnie or Brian. While one may offer more lucrative rewards, all that glitters isn't necessarily gold in GTA 6 . If you hover your cursor over a fencing location icon on the GTA 6 map , you can see the rate each respective fence is offering for narcotics, marked bills, and jewelry. In GTA 6 Chapter 1 , Donnie (Donnie's Trailer) pays low for narcotics, and very low for jewelry and marked bills. Brian (Brian's Lockup), on the other hand, pays very low for all three types of illicit products. As such, Donnie pays more than Brian for narcotics. For example, if you collect all the cocaine drops Cal tells you about after the Clean Up After Donnie mission and fence them, Donnie offers you $3,400, while Brian offers just $2,720. Do note that the time it takes for these payments to reach your mailbox can be impacted by any available missions. While Donnie pays more, Cal suggests you sell the cocaine drops you collect to Brian, by depositing them at Brian's Lockup in Key Lento. He doesn't say why, but he seems to know something you don't. You should listen to Cal and sell your goods to Brian as the events of a later mission, called Swamped, might impact any payments Donnie owes you in GTA 6 (be aware of major spoilers by following that link). Note that if you sell to Brian and he seems to be taking his time to pay you, there may be an available Brian mission you must complete before your payment is sent to the mailbox at Jason's House. © GamesRadar+. sources.title: What Was in Mandy’s Sink in GTA 6?
sources.text: Mandy gives off extreme femme fatale vibes. The beauty outside is clear to see, but beneath the surface, something might be lurking. This might be supported by what Jason finds in Mandy’s sink. Poor Jason, one second he’s fixing a sink, the next he’s questioning everything. One of GTA 6 ‘s early missions is a fun one where you have to fix Mandy’s sink, but the blockage is caused by a sus item. You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! It’s never been confirmed, but when you slow the footage down and gather up all the facts, it seems apparent that Mandy’s sink blockage was either caused by, or not helped by, a human finger. Something’s not right with Mandy the second she closes the cigar box. True, her little speech about checking someone’s social media to see what they’re doing doesn’t help, and Jason’s line about being a ‘stalker’ also suggests some history. But when Jason finally unclogs the sink pipe, something falls out. I’ll be honest, when I first saw it and watched it back, I thought it was either a pregnancy test, a vape, or some kind of personal toy . When you think it could be a finger, it makes a lot more sense. I’m also convinced that Jason says: “Is that a f…” and is cut off before he can say “finger.” I’ve even zoomed in on the image, and if you look closely, it definitely looks like a bone in the middle! Mandy has, allegedly, a finger lodged in her sink, as there’s evidence to suggest she’s some kind of murderer or serial killer in GTA 6. Who is Mandy in GTA 6? It’s a great question. If you delve deeper into her life—a bit weird in its own right, but self-preservation is justified here—you can find her car behind the house. If you check the trunk, you’ll find a bunch of tools and sharp items that would make Dennis Reynolds proud. Apparently Mandy has to have her tools? The mystery of the character makes Mandy one of the most amazing and menacing characters in the game. What are your thoughts on her? sources.title: GTA 6 Doesn't Officially Have First-Person, but You Can Force It to — Here's How to Do It
sources.text: GTA 6 may not have launched with the option to play it entirely in first-person, but where there’s a will, there’s a way. Players have already worked out how to switch from the default third-person perspective, and it requires quite a few fiddly button presses. While you can’t play through the whole of GTA 6 from behind Jason and Lucia’s eyes, there are certain moments where that is a valid option. These include clicking in the right analog stick while holding the left trigger with a weapon unequipped to enter “inspect mode,” which lets you get a closer look at things when standing still. Another instance is when pulling up your phone while driving, which puts you behind the wheel, making steering a bit harder while checking your texts. But now the GTA 6 community has unlocked a way to switch into genuine first-person, allowing you to roam Leonida, fire your guns, and rob stores from much closer to the action. Here’s how to do it, although we can’t guarantee how long this method will last before Rockstar issues a patch fixing it. Note: this appears to currently be working on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. It might take a few tries, but once done, you’ll now be locked into first-person for the rest of your session. Dying won’t reset it, but reloading your save or quitting the game will. Just like the method, the results are by no means perfect, though. It’s a little buggy, with some jank to be found with aiming a weapon, or certain animations not quite agreeing with this glitched version of first-person. It does, however, give us a glimpse of what the future may look like for GTA 6. After all, GTA 5 didn’t receive an official first-person perspective option until it was released on PS4 and Xbox One in 2014, a year after its first launch. And, of course players are already using this forced first-person perspective to try to see Jason and Lucia naked in the shower . Under normal circumstances, can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6? We've got the answer . So, will you be putting this first-person bug to the test? And when do you think Rockstar will include it in an official patch? Let us know in the comments. sources.title: How to make money in GTA 6
sources.text: What is the best way to make money in GTA 6? GTA 6 is finally here and players around the world are getting a chance to jump in to the world of Grand Theft Auto 6 after 13 years. However in GTA 6, money isn’t easy to get early in the game, and as such players have been looking for a way to make money fast in GTA 6. In this guide we’ll list the best ways to make money and GTA 6 from early game stick-ups which you can do almost from the start of the game, to later-game bank robberies which will yield the highest rewards but are also the most difficult. If you are enjoying GTA 6 you should check out our GTA 6 Guides Hub and make sure you bookmark it. We will be updating that hub every day for the forseble future with new guides new walkthroughs and everything you need to know about Grand Theft Auto 6. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Robbing groceries stores in Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the fastest ways to make money though you might not make a lot of it. Every groceries store in the game can be robbed. You can do this by going up to the cashier and sticking them up with a weapon. To do this approach, the cashier and hold the L2 button. This will aim your gun at the cashier without firing however at this point you can now interact with the cashier and threaten them which will cause them to open the cash register. You won’t get a lot of cash doing it this way, however there is little police response when you rob groceries stores. Some grocery stores also have a safe in the back room or you can access by kicking down the door or forcing the employee to open it for you. If that safe has a code you can often find the code on a post-it note located near the safe, or you can threaten the employee and you will get an option to ask them about the safe code. Eventually the police will be contacted and they will turn up at the store but by that point you should be long gone. It’s also worth noting that a lot of grocery stores have secret rooms of that sometimes include gang activity. you can tell if one of the grocery stores has a secret room by checking the minimap if there is a room that you haven’t accessed yet try picking the lock off the door or going back outside and checking another entrance. When you first get the ability to sell drugs, you can start robbing gang hideouts which often contain large amounts ofÂ various drugs that sell for a lot of money. This is by far one of the best ways to make money in GTA 6. The type of drug that the gang hideout is hiding has a huge effect on what it is worth for example things like weed are fairly cheap, but things like crystal and cocaine are far more expensive. You will know you are near a gang hideout because when will drive past and a yellow icon will appear on your map. At this point it is worth checking out what is there and if you check on the map you can also see the valuables that are available and that gang hideout If you steal drugs from a gang hideout you will have to physically take them to somewhere that you can sell them. However, later in the game if you do a lot of drug selling, some buyers will allow you to drop the drugs and a garage. Keep in mind, however, they will arrange a pick up and this means they will take a bigger cut of the money. Robbing jewellery stores and pawn shops is also a great way to make money in GTA 6. Howeverm these jewelry stores and pawn shops often have a high level of security so you are going to want to do some reconnaissance before you attempt to rob them. A lot of jewelry shops can be accessed from the back of the shop, where you will also be able to disable their security systems or if they have CCTV camera footage,Â you can destroy it.Â Doing this will delay the response time of the police, which is important because stealing from jewelry shops or pawn shops gets you a higher wanted level than stealing from a grocery store. One of the best ways to make money and Grand Theft Auto 6 is by completing main story missions. Often these main story missions will give you a big chunk of cash, so it’s worth doing as many of them as you can. This also applies to side missions which often provide you with a lot of cash. Just remember to take it to the bank to put in your account or it could be a lost if you are arrested or die. If you don’t have a bank account yet, check out our guide to Buck Me.Â Another great way to make money in GTA 6 is to sell cars. You will gain the ability to sell cars to Moses when you reach chapter 2 of GTA 6. He will take cars that do not have a tracker on them. On average you will get between $1000 and $5,000 dollars per car that you sell to Moses. After you sell a car to Moses there is a cooldown period where you can no longer sell cars to him however if you sleep at the safe house this cooldown period will elapse. Later in the game you can sell higher value cars to another prominent side character that is introduced and a later chapter . The ultimate way to make money and Grand Theft Auto 6 is to rob a banks.Â You won’t be able to rob banks straight away, in fact you will have to wait until you get the dye pack jammer during a mission where you rob a bank with a prominent side character. After this, you can rob banks whenever you like and it is by far the easiest way to make a huge amount of money in the game. Bank robberies are split up into several sections. There are basic cash drawers which you can get by threatening the tellers, there are safe which hide large numbers of marked bills, and then there are the bank vaults which house the largest amounts of money and in the game. With that being said, because of the amount of money you can get from robbing a bank, actually robbing a bank is also one of the most difficult things to do in the game. The police response is huge as soon as they are called so make sure you’re escape plan

sources.title: When Can You Freely Play As Lucia In GTA 6?
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 was always sold as a Bonnie and Clyde âstyle love story that gives equal weight to both members of its central criminal couple, but the opening hours have you playing almost exclusively as Jason, rather than Lucia. The early segments will occasionally swap you between them as part of the story, but the option to manually switch between the two doesnât come until several hours in.Â So how long do you have to wait to be able to play as Lucia whenever you want? Youâll have to finish the gameâs first chapter which, if youâre taking your time instead of sprinting through the main plot, can take you around a dozen or more hours to complete. Youâll be able to play as Lucia a little bit in that time, but the first chapter is, by and large, a Jason-centric series of events. Chapter 2, meanwhile, puts Lucia at the forefront, and youâll play as her for several missions before you finally unlock the ability to swap between both characters after the quest âBreakfast Run.â Once you unlock the ability to switch between both, you do so by holding right on the d-pad. From then on, you can freely explore as either character, but there will be some missions that require you to play as one or the other, so even if you prefer one character, youâll still have to play as their better half every now and then. Like in Grand Theft Auto V , while youâre playing as one character, the other will be moving around autonomously, and if you switch, that person wonât be where you left them. sources.text: Glitch Grand Theft Auto 6 Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Outside of aiming with certain weapons, Grand Theft Auto 6 is a strictly third-person game, at least for now. But one player has already found a way to turn on an unofficial first-person mode using a glitch. It’s fairly simple, and players are already using it to creep on Lucina. The trick was shared on YouTube yesterday by glitch hunters oneboyler and OrangeGuy and it’s straightforward enough that anyone should be able to do it. It revolves around spamming a button press while Jason is looking at his phone in his car. The first thing players need to do is go to the controller settings menu and change the touchpad button on the PlayStation 5 DualSense from bringing up the map to controlling the camera. The second thing they need to do his get into a car and pull out Jason’s phone. Here comes the glitch part. You press up on the D-pad to put away your phone and spam the touchpad button while doing so. Try it a couple times and if you’ve nailed the timing at least once, you’ll be locked in a first-person view once you get out of the car again. The game should stay this way until the next time you shut it off. First Person Lucia in Shower by u/knowledgable_ in GTA I’ve mentioned Jason doing this, but obviously the trick is the same if you’re controlling Lucia. And, well, at least some players have been going into first-person mode as her and then getting showers. Normally, the characters’ backs are to the camera when they’re getting washed, but in first-person mode you are the character and you can see, well, almost everything .Â Presumably, this should also work for Jason when he’s getting changed. Rockstar Games hasn’t promised a first-person mode will get added to the game in the future, but it did confirm that was an option. GTA 5 and GTA Online didn’t launch with first-person modes either, but each got them when the PS4 and Xbox One versions launched the following year. sources.title: How to Get Ready for November 19
sources.text: November 19, 2026, has long been circled on your calendar. Birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays have come and gone, but this day belongs to you and your XBOX console. We can hardly believe it’s almost here, either. Once midnight strikes, you want to be locked in the action, so to help you prepare, we created a checklist to ensure distractions are put to bed so you can settle in for a season of gaming like nothing you’ve ever experienced before. 2026 has been full of some absolute bangers: Gears of War E-Day, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Forza Horizon 6, Halo: Campaign Evolved, Minecraft Dungeons II, Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred , Control Resonant , Mixtape , Pragmata , The Blood of Dawnwalker , Star Wars: Galactic Racer , 007 First Light , Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve … seriously, all these games came out this year . That also means you might have a hard drive that is nearing capacity. And you will be faced with some hard choices to free up approximately 212GB of space on your XBOX Series X|S before November 19. You could always upgrade the capacity of your console to keep all your games at the ready, using the storage expansion slot on the back of the console. Otherwise, you’ll have a hard choice to make which we do not envy. But know that you’re in good company – we had to find a way to make room too. XBOX Cloud Gaming means that you don’t need to own an XBOX Series X|S console to experience the latest games (or use up that hard drive space) – you can stream directly from the cloud to your XBOX One console. Game Pass subscribers receive an allotment of hours per month as part of their plans, but you can also purchase blocks of time . Certain upcoming major releases have been confirmed as cloud-ready on day one , so even if you don’t own a current gen console, your latest obsession isn’t out of reach. You never want to settle in for a long gaming session only to immediately get hit with an update download. If you haven’t used your XBOX Series X|S or XBOX One in a minute, be sure to power up and connect to the internet beforehand and make sure you’re all set with the latest system updates. You can also install any upcoming releases you may have pre-ordered, while you’re at it. If you’re feeling a gaming flu coming on (and there’s a lot of that going around right now), then take a sick day, rather than risk infecting your coworkers or classmates. Sometimes you just need to listen to your body’s needs, relax, and let the fever run its course. Miami’s own DJ Khaled, aka Dr. XBOX will write you a personalized note to help explain the situation. If this thing is really serious, you may even need the whole week to recover – it’s the responsible thing to do. We all have responsibilities. Some of them come with four legs and a suspect bladder. Don’t let Rufus ruin your gaming fun. Get ahold of a local dog walker to take them outside so you can enjoy the big day uninterrupted. Or drop them off at doggie daycare for a day (or week) to get them out of your hair. Is your XBOX in an area of the house that is easily accessible to younger players? Consider the steps you need to take to get it out of younger sightlines, like running an extension cable out to the shed in the backyard or huddling up in your at-home office. Even if you do find yourself bouncing between rooms, your save files reside in the Cloud, allowing you to pick up your session wherever you last plugged your console in. We’re always on the hunt for new tunes and one of the things we’re most looking forward to on November 19 is discovering a whole bunch of new tracks that are sure to make our listening playlist pop throughout the year. You can get started here on Spotify . XBOX Design Lab lets you create your own next-gen XBOX Wireless Controller. Choose from a combination of colors, patterns, textured grips, and more. You could even pick up some specially themed versions of controllers styled in hot pink and pastels – this one is particularly striking . Speaking of controllers, if you expect long gaming sessions in your near future, make sure that it’s plugged in so it has a full charge when you need it, or stock up on AA batteries. Maybe even get a backup controller ready so you can hot-swap them in and minimize interruptions. Looking for something to add to your queue? Check out the 1967 classic, “Bonnie and Clyde,” featuring Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway to get you in the mood for an epic story about two tragic lovers who fall into a life of crime. We’ll have to wait and see if the outcome is any different this time around starting on November 19.

sources.title: How To Get A Bank Account in GTA 6
sources.text: Most of us take a bank account for granted in real life, but GTA 6 requires you to get one for Jason and Lucia. A fundamental basic for grown-ups, Jason and Lucia’s lives have made getting one difficult, but not impossible. I approached an ATM in GTA 6 ‘s early hours as Jason, and a notification popped up saying I needed a bank account. Not only that, but lots of weapons and items are locked out until you get a bank account—so let’s get one! You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! You get a bank account during Chapter 1, once Lucia is out of prison and reunited with Jason, and she asks Jason if they can get a bank account. In Chapter 1, the time comes for Jason to bring Lucia home. You have an evening at a bar with friends; there’s a fist fight outside, and Jason and Lucia (presumably) get quite naked with each other. However, shortly after you’re reunited, you’ll get a phone call from Lucia, asking about a bank account, and Jason replies that he hasn’t got one. As you know, Jason has a stash at his house which acts as a bank account. A main story mission sees you go to Fleeca Bank to get a bank account, and despite the bank being unable to give you a proper account, you will gain a wonderfully named BuckMe account, which you can use as an app on your phone, and it lets you finally use ATMs. BuckMe lets you deposit and withdraw money and essentially replaces the more cumbersome stash system in GTA 6. There’s a kiddish charm about having money under a floorboard, but it’s not practical for a grown adult who needs to keep thousands of dollars secure. BuckMe acts like a normal banking app, and you can also use it to increase your savings account, required to progress through the main story, as Jason and Lucia create a savings account to earn money for their child. sources.title: Cyberleek Returns for GTA 6 Launch to Reportedly Release a Near-Complete Xbox Build, Threatens to Release the Game's Executable in Days
sources.text: Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 to allegedly release a near complete Xbox build of the game — and has threatened to release its executable in just days. It was thought that the person or group responsible for the online Cyberleek persona had ended their spate of GTA 6 leaks last month, after their memecoin crashed despite efforts to boost its market cap. In October, Cyberleek had tied various types of GTA 6 gameplay leaks to the Cyberleek market cap, and threatened to release a build of the game — supposedly over 200 GB in size — if the memecoin hit a $30 million market cap. Gameplay clips reportedly leaked at the time allegedly showed Lucia fully naked — something that is not possible in the final launch version of the game. Yesterday, November 19 — the GTA 6 release date — Cyberleek returned to drop a GTA 6 Xbox build without the game's executable. In a statement reportedly published online , Cyberleek claimed this Xbox build is a “full November 2026 build of GTA 6.” They predicted this Xbox build would be used to emulate GTA 6 on PC “within a week, running far past 30fps.” The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Cyberleek has revived their crypto scheme, promising to release the executable immediately if it hits a $15 million market cap. While the CyberLeek memecoin was boosted in value by the news to $1.9 million yesterday, it is unlikely to get anywhere near the target. Still, Cyberleek has vowed to release the final file anyway on November 23, whether the memecoin hits the market cap or not. The release of a full and recent build of GTA 6 would of course be hugely damaging for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two, which appears to have been unable to deter Cyberleek’s actions in any meaningful way since their spate of leaks began. It would also run counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch. Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000. IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats. Cyberleek had threatened Rockstar and Take-Two with the release of a full playthrough of the game’s story if they failed to release GTA 6 on-disc and issue a public apology — and the market cap of the memecoin hit $30 million. Of course, few believe these GTA 6 leaks are about campaigning for physical media — rather they're about making money from a crypto scam. Cyberleek appeared to go dark after a spate of high-profile GTA 6 leaks in August that sparked an investigation from Take-Two. The company issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of the hunt for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, or any potential build of the game it's taken from, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security. In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19. Whether the culprit or culprits are ever caught may rest on how successful Take-Two's legal team and the relevant authorities are at forcing social networks or crypto exchanges to divulge any personal details they hold on those responsible. sources.title: GTA 6 Players Are Refusing to Make Use of an Infinite Money Glitch They Say Ruins the Experience
sources.text: Players have already found ways to farm infinite money, undermining the carefully paced economy of GTA 6 using multiple methods. While this happens with every game, it’s particularly strange here. Why is it weird? GTA 6 already has infinite money. You can rob as many stores and businesses as you like and fence the goods, and while stores close down for a while after they’ve been robbed, they reset on a frequent basis. You just have to play as intended, but some players are hellbent on farming cash in the most mind-numbing ways possible. The methods are all built around forcing the store closure timers to reset, so you can rob the same stores on repeat. First, they rob a bunch of stores and collect as much as possible, then they trigger a mission to start a cutscene. Once the cutscene begins, they restart the mission from the menu. When the cutscene begins again, they quit out of the mission, which forces all the stores to reset. Honestly, it sounds arduous and you’d be better off exploring to find new robbery opportunities so you can experience fresh gameplay. Another method sees players go to a lucrative building, get all of the money and narcotics from inside, and store them in the trunk of their car. Next they save the game and immediately load it up. The bags remain in your car, but the building’s loot resets, allowing you to rinse and repeat. Most players agree that this is probably the worst way to experience GTA 6. “Nah I’m good! Didn’t wait 13 years just to glitch my way through the game,” said one fan . “Takes away from the experience,” another poster agreed . “The games (sic) way too immersive to just skip the grind, takes the fun out of it.” Another said : “Nah I prefer to just, ya know, play the game and earn it.” There are seemingly dozens of variations of this glitch, with the method slightly varying between them. In another , the player robs a different location and fences the goods before saving and reloading to reset the location’s loot. Again, this genuinely seems like a miserable way to play the game — especially since more exciting and lucrative robbery opportunities open up as you progress through the story. It’s also probably just a matter of time until Rockstar patches it out. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. sources.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered an Infinite Money Glitch
sources.text: These get rich quick schemes have the fanbase divided Many players have a habit of optimizing the fun out of video games, and that tendency has unsurprisingly found its way into Grand Theft Auto 6 . Apparently, the game has many ways to “get rich quick,” and these exploitive strategies are going viral online. In one method, the player drives to the Apollo Aggregates warehouse in South Vice-Dale County, where a drug deal went wrong. The building is full of narcotics, spare bills, and dead bodies, letting you easily pillage close to $8,000 worth of loot. After grabbing the goods, the player stores the contraband in their car, then saves and loads to teleport back to their house. At this point, they bring the contraband to Brian’s place to cash out. A YouTube video outlining the method claims you can make around $4,000 every five minutes, which is more efficient than nearly everything else in the early game. In another strategy that falls more into the "glitch" category, the player robs the stores near Jason’s house, loses the cops, and then enters any story mission. After the story mission cutscene begins, the player selects Restart Mission in the menu and then pauses and quits. This causes all the stores the player just robbed to instantly reopen with new loot, allowing them to rob them again. However, despite how efficient these early-game earning strategies are, many players are swearing off the temptation. “Nah I’m good! Didn’t wait 13 years just to glitch my way through the game,” one user wrote on X . “Top tip, if you just play the game the amount of money you can make is unlimited, no special trick needed,” a sardonic YouTube comment reads . These users point out that earning so much money early undermines the game’s economy, ruins the gradual progression of unlocking better gear, and invalidates many of the game’s cash-earning side missions. On top of this, these methods directly counter the narrative flow of GTA 6 , which is about Lucia and Jason attempting to scrape together some semblance of the fabled “American Dream.” While some are baffled by why anyone would use such mind-numbing strategies, players are obviously entitled to play the game however they want . Still, it seems likely that Rockstar will patch the game soon to remove these methods, especially the second one, which seems to be a bug. Grand Theft Auto 6 is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

sources.title: GTA 6 won't let you use cheats until you complete the main story, and locks progression when you do
sources.text: Here's a twist: you can't use cheats in Grand Theft Auto 6 until you complete the entire game's main story. That's what we discovered from our tests at least, after loading in saves at various points through the game to be sure, and it's also both a first for the series and a departure even from how developer Rockstar handled cheats in Red Dead Redemption 2 . In that game,approximately half of the cheats were available from the off, and the other half required discovering specific newspapers from around the game's world to unlock. In GTA 6, you'll again need to do some legwork. This time it appears that all of the game's cheats not only require you to finish the story, but also complete various tasks or challenges to unlock them. The way it works is simple enough. Once you finish the main story, the "Cheats" tab - previously hidden - quietly appears at the far end of the Progress menu, accessible when you open the in-game map and scroll with the bumper buttons. From there, you can view various sub-sections of cheats, sorted by category, and a list of 10 or so cheats for each. With each cheat there'll be a short explanation of what it does, and what's required to unlock it and, once unlocked, guidance on how to perform it. This is done via whipping out your phone, holding down the shoulder buttons and using various D-Pad inputs - much the same as GTA 5 . There's also another caveat to bear in mind: when you use a cheat, you'll see a notification warning you that the game can't be saved while it's active, and that Trophies and Achievements are also disabled until you end that session. This makes sense, once you understand the nature of GTA 6's story - there is a cheat for giving yourself a load of money, for instance; another departure from GTA 5 where that popular cheat was removed - but given you'll need certain amounts of cash at various points of the story, enabling you to shortcut that would disrupt the way the narrative unfolds. We'll have a guide from yours truly to all the game's cheats live on Eurogamer in the very near future, as the game releases here in the UK. In the meantime, if you find yourself on the fence about this one, be sure to give our GTA 6 review a look. As I put it there, giving the game five stars: it is "the most believable and unbelievable video game world ever made".
